column5: a command, request or prohibition is addressed to the listener
しよう/しましょう: the speaker (with the listener)
たい and the volitional in a statement: the speaker
たい in a question: the listener (行きたい?)
humble verbs (参る, 申す, いたす): the speaker
a respectful verb in a question: the listener
a respectful verb in speech is never the speaker; the listener by default
くれる/くださる: the giver is not the speaker
～てくれる? / ～てください: the listener gives
evidentials (らしい, そうだ, ようだ) report someone else
a topic person word (俺は) names the subject
a topic person word (お前は) names the subject
a topic name or person word names the subject
